pronounce a word: When I don't know how to pronounce a word, I use an online dictionary to listen to it.
當我不知道某個字怎麼發音時，我會用線上字典聽它的發音。
pronounce someone dead: Only a doctor has the right to pronounce someone dead after checking the heart and breathing carefully.
只有醫生在仔細檢查心跳和呼吸後，才有權宣告某人死亡。
pronounce judgment: After listening to both sides for three days, the judge will pronounce judgment on Friday morning.
聽完雙方三天的陳述後，法官將在星期五早上宣判。
pronounce them husband and wife: At the end of the wedding, the priest smiled and said, "I now pronounce them husband and wife."
婚禮最後，神父微笑著說：「我現在宣布他們結為夫妻。」
prop up the economy: The government spent billions of dollars to prop up the economy after many factories closed during the crisis.
危機期間許多工廠倒閉後，政府花了數十億元來支撐經濟。
prop up the regime: For years, foreign money and weapons helped to prop up the regime, even though most citizens hated it.
多年來，外國的金錢和武器幫助扶植政權，儘管大多數人民都痛恨它。
prop the door open: It was so hot in the classroom that we used a chair to prop the door open and let in some air.
教室裡太熱了，我們用一張椅子把門撐開，讓空氣流通。
prop against the wall: Don't leave your bike in the middle of the hall; just prop it against the wall near the stairs.
別把你的腳踏車停在走廊中間；把它靠牆放在樓梯旁邊就好。
business prospers: When business prospers, the owner of the bakery can hire more workers and open a second shop.
生意興隆時，麵包店老闆就能雇更多員工，再開第二家店。
the town prospered: After the new factory opened, the town prospered, and many families could finally afford new homes.
新工廠開幕後，小鎮繁榮起來，許多家庭終於買得起新房子。
prosper in a new job: With her friendly personality and strong English skills, Lisa will surely prosper in a new job abroad.
憑著友善的個性和優秀的英文能力，麗莎一定能在國外的新工作上順利發展。
protest against the war: Thousands of students marched through the city streets to protest against the war and ask for peace.
數千名學生走上市區街頭，抗議戰爭並呼籲和平。
protest one's innocence: Even after he was sent to prison, the man continued to protest his innocence in letters to newspapers.
即使被送進監獄，那名男子仍持續寫信給報社聲明自己無辜。
protest the decision: Many parents gathered outside the city hall to protest the decision to close the only school in the village.
許多家長聚集在市政府外，抗議關閉村裡唯一一所學校的決定。
under protest: The players left the field under protest after the referee made a very unfair call in the last minute.
裁判在最後一分鐘做出非常不公平的判決後，球員們勉強服從地離開球場。
provoke anger: The rude comments about the singer's family were sure to provoke anger among her many fans online.
那些關於歌手家人的無禮言論必定會在網路上激起她眾多粉絲的憤怒。
provoke a reaction: The artist painted the strange picture on purpose to provoke a reaction from people walking by.
這位藝術家故意畫了那幅奇怪的畫，想引起路人的反應。
provoke laughter: Uncle Ben's silly dance at the wedding party never fails to provoke laughter from all the guests.
班叔叔在婚宴上的滑稽舞蹈總能引發所有賓客的笑聲。
provoke a debate: The movie's ending was so surprising that it is sure to provoke a debate among viewers on social media.
這部電影的結局太出人意料，一定會在社群媒體上引發觀眾的辯論。
provoke someone into: The bully kept calling Tom names to provoke him into a fight, but Tom just walked away calmly.
那個惡霸一直罵湯姆，想激怒他去打架，但湯姆只是冷靜地走開。
publish a book: My grandmother hopes to publish a book about her childhood, and she has already written ten chapters.
我奶奶希望出版一本關於她童年的書，她已經寫了十章。
publish results: The school will publish results of the entrance exam on its website next Monday at noon.
學校將在下週一中午於網站上公布入學考試的結果。
publish a report: Every year, the environmental group will publish a report on air pollution in the country's biggest cities.
這個環保團體每年都會發表一份關於國內各大城市空氣污染的報告。
publish online: Many young writers now choose to publish online because it is faster and cheaper than printing books.
現在許多年輕作家選擇在網路發表作品，因為比印書更快也更便宜。
pull strings: His uncle tried to pull strings to get him a job at the bank, but the manager refused.
他叔叔試圖動用關係幫他在銀行找份工作，但經理拒絕了。
pull one's weight: In a group project, everyone has to pull their weight, or the others will end up doing all the work.
在小組報告中，每個人都必須盡本分，否則其他人最後就得做完所有工作。
pull together: After the earthquake, the whole village had to pull together to rebuild the school and the temple.
地震過後，全村必須團結起來重建學校和廟宇。
pull out of a deal: The company decided to pull out of a deal with the factory after it found out about the poor working conditions.
公司發現那家工廠的工作環境惡劣後，決定退出交易。
pull off a win: Although our team was behind for most of the game, we managed to pull off a win in the final seconds.
雖然我們隊大半場比賽都落後，但我們在最後幾秒成功贏得勝利。
pull through: The doctors were worried after the car accident, but they believe the young driver will pull through.
車禍發生後醫生們很擔心，但他們相信那位年輕駕駛會度過難關。
pull someone's leg: Don't worry, I'm just trying to pull your leg; there is no math test tomorrow.
別擔心，我只是在跟你開玩笑；明天沒有數學考試。
pull a face: Every time Mom puts broccoli on his plate, my little brother likes to pull a face and push it away.
每次媽媽把花椰菜放到他的盤子上，我弟弟就喜歡扮鬼臉把它推開。
